{{Location disambiguation 2|Boreas Seabed}} {{Mission infobox | name = Boreas Seabed | campaign = Factions | region = The Jade Sea | type = Cooperative | duration = Short | preceded by = [[The Convocation]] | followed by = [[City Under Attack]] }} Win at the [[Luxon]] convocation to claim the [[Spear of Archemorus]]. ==Mission information== ===Requirements=== * Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any characters that have not completed [[The Convocation]] (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from [[Pongmei Valley]] will be closed. :* The Convocation grants access, but any characters that have not completed [[Arborstone]] will be left behind in Pongmei Valley. :* Access through [[Boreas Seabed (explorable area)]] is unavailable because there is no route leading there without having completed Boreas Seabed. ===Objectives=== Triumph in the [[Convocation]] and earn the right to use the Spear of Archemorus against [[Shiro]]. * Defeat the three Champions and their Seaguard. * Retrieve the Spear of Archemorus. * Defeat [[Zhu Hanuku]] using the Spear of Archemorus. ===Reward=== {{Mission rewards|Factions | Objective = Completion Time | Reputation = Luxon | ObjNMstd = > 25 minutes | ObjNMexp = 20 - 25 minutes | ObjNMmstr = < 20 minutes | ObjHMstd = > 25 minutes | ObjHMexp = 20 - 25 minutes | ObjHMmstr = < 20 minutes | XPNMstd = 1,000 | XPNMexp = 1,500 | XPNMmstr = 2,000 | XPHMstd = 1,000 | XPHMexp = 2,000 | XPHMmstr = 3,000 | GoldNMstd = 100 | GoldNMexp = 150 | GoldNMmstr = 200 | GoldHMstd = 200 | GoldHMexp = 300 | GoldHMmstr = 500 | PtsNMstd = 1,000 | PtsNMexp = 1,000 | PtsNMmstr = 1,000 | PtsHMstd = 1,000 | PtsHMexp = 1,000 | PtsHMmstr = 1,000 }} ==Walkthrough== Defeat the three Luxon clans and their champions one by one to earn the right to challenge [[Zhu Hanuku]]. Each group has two bosses, and the next will enter the arena as soon as the previous group is killed. The [[Crab Clan]] will be your first opponent from the South-East corner. The [[Serpent Clan]] seconds from the South-West corner. And last the [[Turtle Clan]] from the North-West lead by [[Argo]], a very hard elementalist boss who uses [[Argo's Cry]], a skill stronger than [[Meteor Shower]] ([[interrupt]]s highly recommended). Since they all [[spawn]] inside narrow corridors, use its gate as choke points before they spread. {{a}} [[Luxon Assassin]] |} Winning the [[Convocation]] gives you access to the [[Spear of Archemorus]], an optional and recommended bundle item that can deal a max damage of 1900 at its level five when dropped (see its cumulative power [[Spear_of_Archemorus_(skill)|here]]). Take it and head towards the [[Kraken]] boss, avoid [[aggro]] while fighting it. This is a dangerous enemy: its [[Jade Fury]] skill deals significant [[area of effect]] damage and also has two resurrection skills to bring back the Kraken Spawns. Fortunately, its skills have long [[activation time]], which can be easily interrupted. ===Skill recommendations=== * [[Interrupt]]s or [[daze]] skills to counter [[Argo]] and [[Zhu Hanuku]] e.g. [[Broad Head Arrow]] which can be captured from [[Daeman]] in this mission itself. * A [[minion master]] and/or [[spirit spammer]], since [[minion]] and [[spirit]] deaths charge the spear. * [[Frozen Soil]] can be useful versus the Luxon clans as their bosses carry [[Resurrection Signet]]. == NPCs == === Allies === [[Human]]s (as spectators) * {{n}} 20 [[Alpheus]] * {{n}} 20 [[Cyril]] * {{n}} 20 [[Elder Casta]] * {{n}} 20 [[Elder Cleo]] * {{n}} 20 [[Fern]] * {{n}} 20 [[Kaj]] * {{n}} 20 [[Linus]] * {{n}} 20 [[Remick]] * {{rt}} 20 [[Master Togo|Togo]] * {{x}} 20 [[Elder Rhea]] === Foes === [[Animal]]s ([[Luxon]]s) *{{x}} 20 (20) [[Pet]] - [[Reef Lurker|Elder Reef Lurker]] [[Leviathan (species)|Leviathans]] * {{w}} 24 (26) [[Leviathan Claw]] [[Fish]]es * {{mo}} 22 (26) [[Scuttle Fish]] * {{a}} 22 (26) [[Creeping Carp]] [[Human]]s (Luxons) * {{w}} 20 (26) [[Luxon Warrior]] * {{r}} 20 (26) [[Luxon Ranger]] * {{n}} 20 (26) [[Luxon Necromancer]] * {{me}} 20 (26) [[Luxon Mesmer]] * {{e}} 20 (26) [[Luxon Elementalist]] * {{a}} 20 (26) [[Luxon Assassin]] [[Kraken]]s * {{me}} 24 (26) [[Kraken Spawn]] [[Naga]] * {{w}} 23 (26) [[Naga Warrior]] * {{r}} 24 (26) [[Naga Archer]] * {{rt}} 24 (26) [[Naga Ritualist]] [[Plant]]s * {{mo}} 28 (30) [[Island Guardian]] [[Wallow]]s * {{n}} 24 (26) [[Rot Wallow]] ==== Bosses ==== [[Human]]s ([[Luxon]]s) * {{w}} 24 (30) [[Seaguard Eli]] → [[Dragon Slash]] * {{r}} 24 (30) [[Aurora]] → [[Barrage]] * {{r}} 24 (30) [[Daeman]] → [[Broad Head Arrow]] * {{mo}} 24 (30) [[Seaguard Gita]] → [[Life Sheath]] * {{me}} 24 (30) [[Seaguard Hala]] → [[Power Leech]] * {{e}} 24 (30) [[Argo]] → [[Mind Burn]] [[Kraken]] * {{me}}{{mo}} 30 (32) [[Zhu Hanuku]] == Dialogue == ===[[The Convocation (cinematic)|Opening cinematic]]=== :'''Togo:''' ''"First we locate Elder Rhea. Where?"'' :'''Brother Mhenlo:''' ''"He was last seen in the undercity, below Kaineng."'' :'''Togo:''' ''"Then we must go the undercity."'' :'''Togo:''' ''"We will take this fight to Shiro."'' == Notes == * After Elder Rhea announces the start, the first gate opens when a player is in or enters the central area around the spear. * You can increase your [[Luxon faction|Luxon Faction cap limit]] by 7,000 by completing this mission along with [[Gyala Hatchery]] and [[Unwaking Waters]]. This increase can only be applied once per account. * [[Archemorus' Strike]] can cause damage (and [[knock down]]) to the [[party]] during the convocation battles, if too many [[creature]]s die near the [[Spear of Archemorus]]. * If your party wipes at the end of the third convocation battle, but your foes somehow die anyhow (e.g. due to spirits, minions, and/or degeneration), your party will be resurrected after the mid-mission cinematic. The ''return to outpost'' window will still appear. * The [[portal]]s to [[Mount Qinkai]] and Zos Shivros Channel are blocked. * Completion of this mission will fill in page #5 of the [[Shiro's Return]] [[storybook]]. * After completing this mission, your party will be taken to [[Zos Shivros Channel (outpost)|Zos Shivros Channel]]. {{anomaly|The [[Spear of Archemorus (skill)|Spear of Archemorus]] deals more damage to Zhu Hanuku than expected; it can exceed 1,900 damage at full charge.}} == Trivia == *Agro's quote "To all those we are about to defeat, I salute you." may be a reference to the famous latin phrase "Ave Imperator, morituri te salutant," which translates to, ""Hail, Emperor, those who are about to die salute you." Though little historical records of the phrase being used exist, it was reportedly used during an event in AD 52 on Lake Fucinus by naumachiarii—captives and criminals fated to die fighting during mock naval encounters—in the presence of the emperor Claudius. Popular culture widely believes this was a standard greeting used by all gladiators entering the Colosseum. {{Factions missions}} [[de:Boreas-Meeresgrund (Mission)]] [[fr:Fonds Marins de Boreas (Mission en mode coopératif)]]
